page.layout: One printed page (p. 88), one column of running text. Running head at top with the page number to its left. No marginal notes. A chapter number stands at the right of the running head. main_text.p: coronationem, necessariam esse misericordiam ad remissionem peccatorum venialium. Sed non dixit, PRÆTER coronationem, sed, CUM coronatione eam esse necessariam. Nam de loco Jacobi, JUDICIUM SINE MISERICORDIA ILLI, QUI NON FECERIT MISERICORDIAM; Ubi ostendit in illo etiam judicio, in quo justi coronantur, injustique damnantur, alios cum misericordia salvandos, alios sine misericordia damnandos. Et paulò post, QUIS GLORIABITUR SE MUNDUM ESSE A PECCATO? Ac per hoc etiam illi Dei misericordia necessaria est. Deinde Augustinus duntaxat ait, Et tunc pro bonorum operum Meritis (nempe improprie dictis, ut sæpe ex Augustino & aliis Patribus probavimus cap. 3.) in ipso judicio, etiam ipsa misericordia tribuetur. Contrà Cardinalis dicit,. Misericordiam debitam esse bonis operibus. Cùm tamen Deus, in judicio, sive damnet, sive parcat, justus est. Patres jam ipsi audiendi sunt. Quomodo verò Augustinus velit bona opera esse Merita, longè molliori sensu, alius erit differendi locus.

p.i: Antiqui Patres causam nostram accuratè defendunt.

page.notes: The page is set with long s; all long s are transcribed as plain s. The running head is printed "ANTIDOTVM" and is given here with u for the vowel. The text is in italic in several places (scripture quotation, Latin citations, the "Merita" word), marked with i tags. Printed "dicit,." after "Cardinalis" and the comma after "Merita," are taken as printed. The first word of the section is set with a large initial T, joined to "Testimonia". The last line ends in the hyphenated "respe-" with the catchword "ctu" at the right below the text. The page number "88" is read from the top left, and the chapter marker "Cap. 10." is not part of the running head.
